layout.$description: Layout values of the tv form factor.

margin.$description: Horizontal margin of the screen's content; on television it keeps content inside the overscan-safe area.

gutter.$description: Space between cards in a shelf or grid.

touchTarget.$description: Smallest size of a pointer or touch target (0 on television, which has none).

sidebar.$description: Width of the column of the expanded sidebar of the desktop layout, its inset included (0 where the form factor has none).

rail.$description: Width of the column of the sidebar collapsed to a rail of icons, its inset included (0 where the form factor has none).

focusScale.$description: Scale of a card that has focus.
